Medium Affected: WATER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 44.238056, -76.542222 (Explicit)
Report Description****THIS IS AN UPDATE TO INCIDENT REPORT #1366454***** UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: - THE CALLER ADVISED 2 RAIL CARS UN3077 ON BOARD - ADIPIC ACID (ENVIRONMENTALLY HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCE SOLID) - IS LEAKING INTO THE WATER. THE OTHER UN2280 ON BOARD - EXAMETHYLENE DIAMINE (SOLID) - FULL LOADS. - THE CALLER STATES THE TRAIN IS ABOUT 13 CARS LONG, WITH 5 CARS IN THE WATER, AND 1 CAR APPEARS TO BE LEAKING. THE CONTENTS OF THE (1) CAR HEXAMETHYLENEDIAMINE (HIGH CORROSIVE). - 4 CARS (ADIPIC ACID), 4 CARS (HEXAMETHYLENEDIAMINE), 5 OPEN TOP CARS, 3 (SCRAP METAL), 2 EMPTY. - BATH ROAD WAS SHUTDOWN BETWEEN ARMSTRONG & QUEEN MARY ROAD. - THE IS 75 PIECES OF THE BRIDGE IN THE WATER. ORIGINAL REPORT \\ NEEC INCIDENT NOTIFICATION: TRAIN DERAILMENT DANGEROUS GOODS INTO WATER | DUPONT CANADA | KINGSTON, ON \\ AT 10:35 ET ON 05 MAY 2023, A CN RAIL TRAIN DERAILMENT IN KINGSTON, ON (INTERSECTION OF BATH ROAD + ARMSTRONG ROAD) OCCURRED DUE TO A BRIDGE COLLAPSING. THERE ARE 2 DANGEROUS GOODS RAILCARS THAT ARE DANGLING DOWN FROM THE BRIDGE AND MAY POSSIBLY FALL IN THE RIVER. ONE (1) HOPPER CAR CONTAINS A LOAD OF ENVIRONMENTALLY HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCES (SOLID), WHILE THE OTHER RAILCAR CONTAINS A CORROSIVE SOLID PRODUCT. FIRE DEPARTMENT AND POLICE ARE ON SITE. BOTH PRODUCTS ARE SOLID, BUT FIRE DEPARTMENT CAN SEE A SHEEN ON THE RIVER. -TRANSPORT CANADA IS CURRENTLY MONITORING THIS SITUATION AND THE REGION HAS BEEN NOTIFIED. -TRANSPORT CANADA WILL PROVIDE UPDATES WHEN/IF INFORMATION BECOMES AVAILABLE. THE REPORT INDICATES THERE WAS A REPORT OF 5 RAILCARS IN THE WATER. (A POND THAT LEADS TO LAKE ONTARIO) NO TRAIN SPECIFIC INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED ON THE REPORT. WITH THE 5 CARS IN THE WATER AND THE 2 HANGING FROM THE BRIDGE, 7 CARS TOTAL HAVE BEEN REPORTEDLY DERAILED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1393540 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: MAGNUS SERVICES
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1393540
Incident Time: 2024-03-09 12:00:00
Nearest City: Watford City, ND
Location: 12638 32ND ST NW
Location2: MAGNUS SERVICES
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: SEWAGE
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: MAGNUS SERVICES
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 47.87599, -103.287166 (Approximated from street_address)
Report DescriptionCALLER REPORTS AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT OF BOTH SEWAGE AND DIESEL HAS BEEN RELEASED / DISCHARGED ONTO THE GROUND/SOIL AND THEN INTO AN UNNAMED CREEK. THE DIESEL HAS COME FROM ABOUT 500 BAGS CONTAINING DIESEL SOAKED RAGS IN A HOLE, AND 3 LEAKING GREY AUTOMATED FUELING UNITS. THE SEWAGE IS COMING FROM A MAKESHIFT PIPE THAT IS DIRECTING SEWAGE TO CREEK. FOR THE LAST 3 YEARS THE OWNER HAD WORKERS DUMP DIESEL SOAKED DIAPERS INTO GARBAGE BAGS AND THEN HAD THOSE BAGS TOSSED INTO A HOLE THAT IS ABOUT 20 FT DEEP, 30 FT WIDE 40 FT LONG THAT THEY CREATED WITH AN EXCAVATOR. CALLER REPORTS THAT THERE IS NO LINING IN THIS HOLE. THE OWNERS INTENT WAS TO EVENTUALLY BURN ALL OF THE BAGS. THE COMPANY OWNER HAD GOTTEN TIPPED OFF THAT THERE WOULD BE AN INSPECTION DONE ON THE PROPERTY BY THE COUNTY AND THEY PROPERLY DISPOSED OF THE 500 BAGS. THE CALLER IS CONCERNED BECAUSE THERE IS AN UNNAMED CREEK THAT MAY BE IMPACTED DO TO ANY RELEASED DIESEL FROM THE BAGS/ AUTOMATED FUELING UNITS AND SEWAGE. THE SNOW RUNOFF COULD THEN IMPACT A LARGER CREEK.

Report Description/// VESSEL FIRE/MASS SAR - 07 JUN 2025/// INCIDENT TYPE: MASS SAR LOCATION: IN VICINITY OF HART ISLAND, NY TIME INCIDENT OCCURRED: 2001 EST / 0001 ZULU TIME OF INITIAL REPORT TO NCC: 2025 EST / 0025 ZULU NAME OF REPORTING UNIT: USCG SECTOR NEW YORK AMPLIFYING INFORMATION: - USCG SECTOR NEW YORK INITIATED A CRITICAL INCIDENT COMMUNICATION CALL FOR A YACHT ON FIRE WITH MULTIPLE PEOPLE IN THE WATER NEAR HART ISLAND, NEW YORK. - INITIAL REPORT OF 20 PERSONS POSSIBLY IN THE WATER, WITH CAUSE OF FIRE UNKNOWN. - INITIAL CALL CAME IN THROUGH FIRE DEPARTMENT NEW YORK (FDNY) OVER THE RADIO. - TWO MARINE UNITS FROM FDNY, LOCAL POLICE, TOW BOAT US AND OTHER GOVERNMENT AGENCIES (OGA) HELICOPTERS ALL RESPONDING. - TWO 45-FOOOT RESPONSE BOATS LAUNCHED FROM USCG STATION NEW YORK, WITH AN ESTIMATED 15-MINUTE ARRIVAL. - SECTOR NEW YORK ISSUED AN URGENT MARINE INFORMATION BROADCAST. - VESSEL TRAFFIC SERVICE NEW YORK WAS NOTIFIED. - OGAS HAVE RECOVERED 12 PERSONS FROM THE WATER. - THE TOTAL NUMBER OF PERSONS THAT WERE ABOARD THE YACHT IS CURRENTLY UNKNOWN. - VESSEL IS CURRENTLY ON FIRE AND TAKING ON WATER. - POLLUTION POTENTIAL AND ACTUAL IS UNKNOWN. - OGA HELICOPTER IS PROVIDING A LIVE FEED ON THE INCIDENT. - THERE HAVE BEEN NO MEDIA INQUIRIES. - ON SCENE WEATHER: 5-8 KNOTS OF WIND, SEA STATE IS LESS THAN 1 FOOT. - A FOLLOW-ON CIC WILL BE HELD AT 2230 EST / 0230 ZULU.
